verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an accounts payable aging report or point-in-time vendor balances. The closest items are MCP tools that expose bills and vendors data, a 'top vendors by spend' example, and a cash forecast built from open bills. These are adjacent data access and forecasting features, not an AP aging or as-of vendor balance view, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
